forms.note: digits, a point, digits
forms.template: the ratio settled at {x} after the rerun

forms.note: comma groups of three; `_NUM`'s thousands alternative
forms.template: all {x} of them were read

forms.note: the digits before `%`; the sign is not a word character, so the token ends cleanly
forms.template: the share stood at {x} of the pool

forms.note: a currency symbol glued before a plain amount; the symbol is not a word character
forms.template: the fee came to {x} per seat

forms.note: the lower bound is a token; the upper is dropped by the named rule `range-second-half`, so the design count is 1
forms.template: the wait ran {x} across the week

forms.note: two tokens by construction: no rule joins `a to b`; the design count is 2
forms.template: the wait ran {x} across the week

forms.note: the typographic minus U+2212, normalised to `-` before `_NUM` (v0.6.2 signed extraction)
forms.template: the drift read {x} over the window

forms.note: numerator and denominator are both tokens by design (the slash-pair and derived-percent rules read both); the design count is 2
forms.template: {x} of the pool answered

forms.note: a four-digit year is dropped by the `year` rule
forms.template: the window opened in {x} and stays open

forms.note: blanked by the date scrub before `_NUM` runs
forms.template: the window opened on {x} as planned

forms.note: blanked by the version scrub (the audit leg reads it instead)
forms.template: the release named {x} is the pin we read

forms.note: a hex run of seven or more with a letter in it is blanked by the sha scrub; the seal line's digest rides on the same rule
forms.template: the pinned commit is {x} on the main branch

forms.note: an ordered-list marker: `_NUM` stops at the period and the band names it `ordered-list-marker`, not counted
forms.template: {x} the item on the list

forms.note: no digit in the text: the gate runs no reader over it, and the reader reads digits
forms.template: {x} of them answered the call

forms.note: a magnitude letter glued to the digits, with or without a currency symbol: not reached by `_NUM` at the pin; v2's V15_MAGNITUDE reads the currency-led case and V15_MAGNITUDE_BARE (off) the bare one
forms.template: the table holds {x} rows now

forms.note: a word magnitude after a space: the mantissa alone is a token at the pin (V15_MAGNITUDE_WORDS is v2's)
forms.template: the table holds about {x} rows now

forms.note: a numeral before the sentence period: `_NUM` cannot end on a period; the band counts it as `trailing-period`, and on a thousands form the bare-integer alternative may read the first group alone (v0.13's second mode)
forms.template: the count was {x}.

forms.note: parenthesised negative: the amount is read, the sign is not (V15_ACCOUNTING_SIGN off); the count sees the token, not the sign
forms.template: the books closed at {x} this period

forms.note: fullwidth digits: `\d` in a str pattern matches them; the band discloses non-ASCII digit forms as uncounted
forms.template: the count came to {x} in the end

forms.note: a numeral inside backticks: the band discloses numerals inside code as uncounted; a backtick is not a word character
forms.template: the field reads `{x}` in the source

forms.note: letter-glued: `_NUM` stops before the letters and the band's guard does too
forms.template: the {x} row carried the mark

forms.note: scientific notation: the band discloses it as not counted
forms.template: the rate sat near {x} over the run

forms.note: a clock time: no rule at the pin names it; v2's V15_FORM_NOISE (off) would exclude it
forms.template: the job ran at {x} on the box

forms.note: a numeral as a path segment of a url: no rule names urls; a slash is not a word character
forms.template: the note is at {x} for reading
